tickets.title: general borrows any role's instructions for one job
tickets.what: Spec §2.1.2/§2.1.4 (D-2026-11-22-29). `hud_create` gains `instructions: "<role>"`, accepted only for `general` (other roles reject it like placement options). The job keeps general's place resolution (preset/on/model/thinking, or general's run chain) and general's concurrency slot, but launches with the named role's instructions: on pi, that role's place pi_role (from its active run's first pi place, else its `instructions` name) and `--hud-instructions <role instructions>.md`; on CLI harnesses (agy, claude, codex), the bundled `<instructions>.md` of that role. Unknown or hidden role → invalid_arguments naming valid roles. Record `instructions_from` on the job and show it in hud_read. Retry and headless resume keep it. Keep the tool schema addition small (one short property line).

acceptance.text: general + instructions:imp on pi launches with pi_role implementer and implementer.md; on agy/claude CLI with implementer.md (fake-bin tests)
non-general roles reject `instructions`; an unknown role is refused with the valid list
retry_of and headless resume keep the borrowed instructions; job record and hud_read show instructions_from
tool schema grows by at most ~80 bytes; docs/reference.md documents it

tickets.title: imp placement mode: fixed, even or auto
tickets.what: Spec §2.1.4 (D-2026-11-22-30). Replace the imp routing on/off setting with a mode: `fixed` (active preset, as routing off today), `even` (rotate through owner-picked presets so each gets about the same number of imp jobs started in the last 24 h; ties go to the preset order in the role file; an unavailable preset is skipped and the result says so) and `auto` (today's routing, unchanged). Store mode and the even pool in the imp role file or Settings, wherever routing lives now; migrate an existing routing toggle (on→auto, off→fixed) on read without rewriting. Settings shows the mode and, for even, lets the owner pick the pool. Create result, card and job record show `placement: even` with the chosen preset (like the routed tier line today). Overflow to general, retry_of and land repair keep the place chosen at create.

acceptance.text: fixed/even/auto each pick the expected preset (unit tests, including even rotation by 24 h job count and skip of an unavailable preset)
existing routing toggle migrates on read: on→auto, off→fixed, file not rewritten
Settings shows and changes the mode and the even pool (EN/ZH); create result and card show the placement
overflow, retry and repair keep the create-time place
